title: Tilt Card
description: A card that tips toward the cursor in 3D, with a glare that follows and a layer that floats.
usage: One card per view earns this — a featured plan, a product shot, the thing being sold. The tilt caps at a few degrees, the glare is a whisper, and an inner layer floats on translateZ so the depth is real. The moment everything on the page tilts, nothing does.
a11y: The tilt is pointer-only garnish on a static card: content, order and actions are identical with the script removed, and touch and keyboard never trigger it. Under prefers-reduced-motion the card stays flat, which suits it fine.
